# How popular is Donald Trump?

Silver Bulletin approval ratings for President Trump — and all presidents since Truman.

🕒 The latest on Trump’s approval rating

Updated November 20, 2026

After rebounding slightly to 38 percent, Donald Trump’s approval rating is back on the downswing. Today, 37 percent of Americans approve of the job he’s doing, while 60 percent disapprove. [...] Just 18.9 percent of Americans strongly approve of Trump, dangerously close to the 18.3 percent who weakly approve. If the president continues to get less popular, those figures could flip in the not too distant future. -EMD, 11/17/26

As of 8:30 a.m. ET on Thursday, November 19, Civiqs’ rolling job-approval tracker, based on 143,723 responses collected between January 20, 2025, and November 18, 2026, found that 33 percent approved of Trump’s handling of the presidency, while 59 percent disapproved and 7 percent expressed no view.

That gives Trump a national net approval rating of minus 26, calculated by subtracting disapproval from approval.
